summary_note: Selection specificity at shallow depth (report section 5.20): three rewound transports per seed on the seed's own initial model, so initialization is matched on every side and only the topology differs. F_own is the unmutated genome and must reproduce the fixed arm's own run exactly. R_own is the control that decides what the advantage means: if churn alone beats the initial topology, A_own_vs_R_own is not evidence of selection. Statistics recompute exactly from per_seed; p-values are exact one-tailed binomial.
